# The Shopper's Verdict

> We read thousands of Amazon customer reviews so you don't have to. Our site delivers unbiased, data-driven product verdicts across 10+ shopping categories. No fluff, no sponsored placements — just the verdict.

We aggregate and analyze real Amazon customer reviews to produce concise buying guides with pros, cons, ratings, and pricing. Every review includes a verdict score (1-5), aggregate Amazon rating, review count, price, pros/cons list, FAQ, and an affiliate link to Amazon. Content is produced by GLYC Digital.

The site has approximately 28,000+ product reviews across 10 core categories. Reviews are organized by category with clean, descriptive URL slugs. Each review page includes JSON-LD structured data (WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Article, Product with AggregateRating and Offer, FAQPage).
